in_marathi.name: Bhabani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhabani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhabani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhaba' which means prosperity. The name signifies the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is believed to bring abundance, riches, and success in life.
